title: Credential Resolver (v0.5)
description: Provider-neutral, runtime-neutral resolver contract of the Agent Credential Layer v0.5. A document validates as either a public-safe ResolverDescriptor (capability metadata, never a credential) or a public-safe ResolverOutcome (sanitized outcome metadata only). The runtime-private CredentialMaterial is intentionally absent: it is never a public JSON shape and never serialized here. Forbidden property names anywhere: token, password, secret, apiKey, credentialValue, authorizationHeader, rawCredential, credentialMaterial. This schema depends on no specific provider; the failure vocabulary borrows the v0.2 diagnostic-code registry and adds a single resolver-specific code (RESOLVER_ERROR) enforced by the validator, not by this schema.

NoSecretPropertyName.description: Any property/attribute name in this contract; public shapes never contain secret-bearing names.

ResolverDescriptor.description: Public-safe capability metadata describing what a resolver can handle. It never contains a credential value, a filesystem/keyring path, a provider command, or agent-visible secret of any kind.

contractVersion.description: Public contract version of the credential resolver layer.

resolverId.description: Stable resolver identifier (for example env, file, keyring, cli-session, connector, external-broker, or a provider-qualified form).

resolverType.description: Family classification. environment and file are protocol-safe; keyring, cli-session, connector, and external-broker may require reference/portable-provider adaptation.

supportedProviders.description: Provider namespaces this resolver can serve. An empty array means provider-agnostic (no constraint), never a secret.

supportedSourceTypes.description: Credential source types this resolver can serve. Always explicit; empty is not allowed because a resolver must declare at least one concrete source type it handles.

supportedHosts.description: Optional host constraints. An empty array means any host (no constraint).

supportedProfiles.description: Optional profile constraints. An empty array means any profile (no constraint).

capabilities.description: Safe operation/capability tokens, for example resolve. Never a credential value.

runtimeRequirements.description: Safe, non-secret runtime hints (for example powershell, node, os-keyring). Must never carry secret material.

ResolverOutcome.description: Sanitized resolver outcome metadata only. It never exposes raw material, filesystem/keyring paths, command stdout/stderr, resolver exception text, or arbitrary plan metadata. The runtime-private CredentialMaterial is intentionally absent.

contractVersion.description: Public contract version of the credential resolver layer.

resolverId.description: Resolver identifier that produced this outcome.

provider.description: Provider this outcome is associated with, when known; sanitized and non-secret.

outcome.description: resolved = material produced under caller bounded control; unavailable = source present but material not currently available; failed = resolver could not produce material.

reasonCode.description: Opaque sanitized reason code, or null for a clean resolved outcome. When present the validator restricts it to the v0.2 diagnostic failure vocabulary plus the single resolver-specific RESOLVER_ERROR.

materialKind.description: How the runtime-private material is delivered. It describes the delivery notion only and never carries a concrete path or value.

target.description: Safe intended injection/use target, for example an environment-variable name or a header name, never a secret value or a filesystem path.

lifetimeSeconds.description: Bounded lifetime of the runtime-private material in seconds, when applicable; null when not applicable.

summary.description: Safe, non-secret, sanitized summary. Never raw, no resolver exception text, no path, no credential value.
